correctness.rationale: The frozen Fourier statement omitted nontriviality of the character: for the trivial character and q=3 its left side is 625/9 and its asserted right side is 77/9. The complete repaired RESULT.md specifies nontriviality and proves the correct orthogonality; it also accurately limits the frozen script to fiber/energy/trace checks. In both versions the energy calculation holds: inclusion–exclusion of the origin, the cubic pair discriminant (4y−x³)/(3x), and the mixed cube-root count give the stated fibers. Summing their squares uses the mixed term Σ_{z≠0}ν(z)χ((4z−1)/3)=T_q−χ(−3). The character vanishes in the bijective-cube case upon summation over all arguments, and T_q=−a_q in the split case from the smooth projective point count; the genus-one characteristic polynomial gives the recurrence. In characteristic three the two disjoint summand subgroups give exactly the three levels 2q−1, q, and 2, whose squares sum to the stated cubic polynomial. This verifies the repaired scope over finite fields, not only prime fields.
residual_risks: The frozen finite tests were not rerun; no independent numerical, formal or expert attestation is claimed.

value.rationale: The high-contact tangent is geometrically natural, and the energy is a standard exact measure of additive collisions. The formula reveals precisely where the mixed collisions retain a nonconstant elliptic trace, where they become purely polynomial, and where the additive-subgroup regime changes the leading term. The value is in this exact arithmetic invariant for the arrangement, not in the normalization fix or in the already available self-convolution.
residual_risks: The result gives neither sharp union restriction extremizers nor an arbitrary-line classification.
